summary.title: Docker Containers Security
summary.one_liner: Learn how Docker internals work, how common misconfigurations can be exploited to escape containers or gain root, and how to secure a Docker environment.
takeaways: How Docker runs containers under the hood, including containerd, runc, resource management and pivot_root
How misconfigurations in Docker setups, such as insecure registries and exposed daemons, can be exploited for root access or container breakout
Hands-on attack topics: image secret hunting, Docker daemon attacks, seccomp-unconfined breakouts and bind mount checks
Defensive practices: AppArmor, seccomp, Dockerfile linting, image vulnerability scanning with Clair, registry TLS, UserNS remapping and Falco monitoring
summary.summary: This is a multi-part course on Docker security by tbhaxor, split into three sections: Docker ecosystem fundamentals, exploiting misconfigurations, and securing Docker environments. The attack section covers registries, images, the Docker daemon, container breakouts and the firewall plugin REST API. The defense section covers AppArmor, seccomp, Dockerfile linters, Clair, Dockscan, UserNS remapping and Falco. The listed prerequisites are Linux privilege escalation knowledge, with Docker basics and Pentester Academy labs as optional extras.
